scenario_title: Redis eviction policy set to noeviction
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-05-10 13:25-17:35: api-gateway: 207 of 292 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-10 13:25 and 2026-05-10 17:35 UTC (peak error ratio 0.87 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.627 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Terraform change set maxmemory-policy {old} -> {new}; when memory filled, Redis rejected writes (OOM command not allowed) and new sessions could not be created.

rca.macro: Terraform change set maxmemory-policy volatile-lru -> noeviction; when memory filled, Redis rejected writes (OOM command not allowed) and new sessions could not be created.
rca.micro: infra/session-cache.tf:113 sets maxmemory-policy volatile-lru -> noeviction on aws_elasticache_parameter_group.session_cache.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `POST <*> <*> <*> target=auth-svc`.
